newsitem.title: USA: TWA in code-share pact with Jordan airline.
newsitem.headline: TWA in code-share pact with Jordan airline.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday it has reached a code-sharing agreement with Royal Jordanian Airlines for flights between the United States, the Netherlands and Jordan.

TWA is the first U.S. airline to have such an agreement, providing service five times a week between New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport, Schiphol Amsterdam and Jordan's Queen Alia International Airport in Amman, TWA said.
The code-sharing will affect TWA flights originating in Chicago, Houston and Los Angeles, with passengers transferring to a Royal Jordanian flight in New York, TWA said.
